designationHistory.name: North Platte Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Woodrow Wilson reserved four Reclamation Service reservoirs west of Scottsbluff, Nebraska, including Lakes Alice and Minatare and Winters Creek Lake, as the North Platte Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds, by Executive Order 2446.
